testcase.name: acl_test: explicit tool, path, network, and evidence grants allow access
acl_test: every known but undeclared access is denied by default
acl_test: evidence ACLs preserve asymmetric defender and prosecutor views
acl_test: all_permitted is an explicit privileged grant but never a request class
acl_test: tool grants do not imply network, evidence, read, or write authority
acl_test: read and write scopes remain independent
acl_test: dotted and colon-delimited capability aliases fail closed
acl_test: unknown tool, evidence, and ACL vocabularies are never treated as denial aliases
acl_test: network ACLs bind exact canonical HTTPS origins
acl_test: access requests reject traversal and accessor or proxy wrappers without execution
acl_test: a tampered RoleSpec cannot authorize any access
role_schema_test: creates a deterministic content-addressed immutable RoleSpec
role_schema_test: set-semantic fields canonicalize while fallback precedence is preserved
role_schema_test: persisted integrity requires canonical ordering, hash, and derived ID
role_schema_test: mission, forbidden behavior, schemas, budget, and expected count are mandatory
role_schema_test: closed vocabularies and relationship constraints fail closed
role_schema_test: scopes reject traversal, absolute paths, separators, and malformed broadening
role_schema_test: duplicates are rejected rather than silently deduplicated
role_schema_test: hostile wrappers, accessors, sparse arrays, and custom prototypes are inert
role_schema_test: RoleDispatchPlan projection is exact, immutable, and provider-neutral
role_schema_test: canonical JSON rejects cycles and non-canonical numeric values
